references.text: The story of Zelophehad's daughters, who first came to Moses with their case about inheritance rights, which led to the Lord's command regarding inheritance for daughters without brothers.
The Lord's command through Moses that Zelophehad's daughters must marry within their own tribe to preserve the inheritance.
Fulfillment of obedience: the names of Zelophehad's daughters who married their cousins from the tribe of Manasseh.
Zelophehad's daughters receive their inheritance in the land of Canaan, confirming their obedience to the Lord's command.
A similar pattern of obedience: The Israelites did everything just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
Moses did in all things just as the Lord had commanded him – a pattern of obedience that Zelophehad's daughters followed.
